units.headline: Adds package-level test hook invoked before head-view eviction
units.summary: Adds a nil-by-default global func var that compactHeadViewLocked calls once and then clears. Production never sets it, so it has no runtime effect outside tests.
units.reason: Test-only hook; nil in production, so the only production cost is a nil check.

units.headline: New func type for building restricted head BlockReader views
units.summary: Unexported type alias for the view factory that compactHeadViewLocked uses. It is a declaration only; the behavior lives in the callers.
units.reason: Type declaration only; the behavior is reviewed in compactHeadViewLocked and its callers.

units.headline: New evictor func type documenting the append-ID watermark contract
units.summary: Unexported func type plus a doc comment on the watermark contract. The claim that the watermark is 0 when isolation is disabled holds: lastAppendID returns 0 when isolation is disabled.
units.reason: Type declaration and docs only; the eviction behavior is in the closures and head.go.

units.headline: Generic head-view compaction with append-ID watermark guard before eviction
units.summary: Pulls the per-chunk-range block write, reload and evict loop into one shared helper, and captures lastAppendID as a watermark that the evictor uses to keep series that got later appends. Empty views are now skipped. The watermark misses appenders that were already open when it was captured, so the race it is meant to close stays partly open.

issues.title: Watermark misses in-flight appenders; doc 'guarantee' is false
issues.failure_scenario: An appender gets appendID N (assigned when the appender is created) and has not committed when the watermark N is captured. The block writer's isolation state treats N as incomplete and leaves out its samples. N then commits a sample with a timestamp <= maxt. hasAppendIDAbove(s, N) returns false, so the series is evicted and a WAL tombstone is written. The committed sample is lost from the head, the block and WAL replay.

units.reason: Core compaction and eviction logic with a new concurrency guard that decides data retention.
focus: Whether the watermark should be the lowest open appendID minus 1 (as in lowWatermark) rather than lastAppendID
That skipping empty views (len(uids)==0) cannot hide a real write failure
Earlier blocks stay on disk when reloadBlocks fails in a later iteration

units.headline: CompactStaleHead now delegates to compactHeadViewLocked with watermark guard
units.summary: Replaces the inline loop with the shared helper, using SelectedSeriesHead instead of StaleHead and passing the watermark into truncateStaleSeries. Stale series that received appends after compaction started are now kept in the head instead of evicted. The block's NumSeries now comes from the ref-list length instead of NumStaleSeries, and empty slices no longer produce log or reload work.
units.reason: Changes eviction conditions and block-writing path for an existing production compaction.
focus: The stale-series predicate plus the watermark keep the old safety (stale and no OOO) intact
Block meta NumSeries change from NumStaleSeries to len(refs)

units.headline: Test comment renamed gcStaleSeries to gcSeries
units.summary: Only a comment in a test changes, to match the renamed function. Nothing executes differently.
units.reason: Comment-only edit in a test file.

units.headline: New test: late append before eviction survives restart
units.summary: Uses the hook to commit a sample after the block write and before eviction, then checks the sample is kept (isolation on) or evicted (isolation off) both before and after a WAL-replay restart. It only covers appends that start after the watermark, not appenders already open when the watermark is taken.
units.reason: New test only; it cannot affect production behavior.
